help.description: Get help documentation for a topic and optional section. Returns help content in JSON format.

topic.description: The help topic to retrieve (defaults to 'help' if not provided)

section.description: Optional specific section within the topic

show_image.description: Show image details by ID. Returns complete image data including usage, instances, and metadata.

id.description: The ID of the image to show

json.description: If true, returns JSON format output (optional)

count_pages.description: Count the total number of pages and images in the database.

show_page.description: Show page with full details by ID, name, or link. Returns complete page data including hierarchy and content.

id.description: The ID of the page to show

name.description: The name/link of the page to show (alternative to id)

link.description: The link of the page to show (alternative to id or name)

get_page.description: Get page data by ID, name, or link. Returns JSON-friendly page data including children, images, and metadata.

id.description: The ID of the page to retrieve

name.description: The name/link of the page to retrieve (alternative to id)

link.description: The link of the page to retrieve (alternative to id or name)
